name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hello. It's been a while."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh. How long *has* it been again? Feels like forever."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It hasn't been that long, at least by my sense of time."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, Shiorin's here too. So you found her?"

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry for the trouble..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. But uh, weren't you stuck in the library?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Thanks to these two, I'm able to leave now. I see you've regained your memories."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep, thanks to these two~"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You've completely stopped coming to the library, haven't you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, Gyaruko-san at the library? That's kind of unexpected."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ghosts have a lot of free time, yeah? So I figured I'd try reading or something, but nah. Wasn't for me. And by the way..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, you. The heck are you just standing there for? That's right, I'm talking to you, buddy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You turn down my invitation, then show up with another woman. What the hell, pal?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And here I was, waiting for you to let me tag along."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I was the one who insisted on coming along. If you are to blame someone, blame me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, I'm just messing around. I wouldn't get angry over something like that."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? How'd it go, Shiorin? You got to talk to that old dude yesterday, yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, we did."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did ya find anything out?"

name: Shiori
message: "His name is Yasuda, and we learned what kind of person he is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What's that supposed to mean, did that old dude spill the beans himself or something?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We looked him up on our buddy's smartphone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Simply put, Yasuda is extremely likely to be the main perpetrator of the case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And considering his actions while he was alive, we've concluded that his testimony isn't trustworthy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, I was asking Shiorin, though..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry for worrying you."

name: Shiori
message: "I was pretty shaken yesterday, but now I've decided to find out the truth myself—no—together."

name: Shiori
message: "And I have you to thank as well, Gyaruko-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh. You're welcome, I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "Right now, we're looking for someone called Girl A, who's connected to the case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If it's okay, would you like to come with us? We'd like to rely on your connections."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, do I really need to tag along? You've already found Shiorin, and all. I'd just get in the way, don'tcha think?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "'Sides, Shiorin still hasn't even gotten her memories back yet, yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. They still haven't returned."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Then I'll do stuff my way. I'll call ya if I find something."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Call?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, it goes through somehow. I don't really get it either."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A phone call with a ghost... I see. A fascinating phenomenon. To have a tie that deep, you must share a very strong connection..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? Connection? Like signal bars and stuff? I dunno, it's not like I'm on some phone plan or anything. Or am I? Dunno."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, not that kind of connection..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I don't really get it, but whatever. Anyway, I'll give you a call if anything comes up."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Very well."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, I'm off. See ya~"
"Thanks for worrying about us."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Aye aye~. Go get 'em, yeah?"
